data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'nazala', meaning 'descended' or 'rained'. In Islamic context, Nazila represents the one who brings delight and beauty to others. The name Nazila carries the meaning “Delight, beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nazila usually hope their child will grow to embody delight, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nazila carries a beautiful connotation in Arabic and Islamic culture. It signifies the one who brings rain, which is a vital source of life. In this context, it can be seen as a symbol of fertility, growth, and renewal. In addition, the term 'Nazila' has been used in Arabic poetry to describe a beautiful woman or a gracious hostess, reflecting the idea of beauty and delight.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name Nazila can be interpreted to have spiritual significance as well. It can be seen as a reminder of the blessings and mercy of Allah that rains down upon us, nourishing our souls as rain nourishes the earth. Moreover, Nazila can be seen as a reference to the descending of the Quran from Allah to Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), which is called 'Wahy' (revelation) in Arabic. In this sense, the name holds a deep spiritual significance, reminding us of Allah's continuous blessings and guidance upon us.
